name: Lilith-Izm08 ~Nobushito Black Izm~
source:
This is the 8th volume of LILITH-IZM! The theme is "Buggery and Darkness"! Amassed collection of spin-offs of high quality, popular Black Lilith titles! Enjoy 3x special Another Stories from MISAO, Magical Girl Fairy Knights and Seduction Emails!

*MISAO - Legend of the Humiliated Ninja -* Another Story
Hotarubi goes to rescue Misao who has been captured by the Rasetsu. She quietly infiltrated the enemy lair but from the start, it was a trap......A trap sprung on Hotarubi in the name of many tortures. The men sate their various appetites. 

*Magical Girl Fairy Knights* Another Story
Il Geer's seductive tricks had the Fairy Knights in a pinch. Seeming to corrupt fully to the depraved curse of planted upon them, they gained a new power to strike back at Ill Geer! Then a decisive battle against the ultimate boss of the Bakdao!

*Me and Saeko and the Seduction Emails* Another Story
Student Kyouichi and his aunt/teacher Saeko were in love. Mutually they carried on the affair at school. It was photographed by her prying coworker Terushima. Thus he was able to sink his poison fangs into not just Saeko, but her daughter Shiho.
A forbidden netorare email to Shiho storyline that couldn't fit in the main release. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094473.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是LILITH-IZM的第8卷！主题是“后门与黑暗”！汇集了高质量、人气Black Lilith作品的番外合集！享受来自《MISAO》《魔法少女妖精骑士》和《诱惑邮件》的3部特别Another Story！

*《MISAO——受辱忍者传说》*Another Story
萤火前往营救被罗刹掳走的美沙尾。她悄然潜入敌人的巢穴，但从一开始这就是一个陷阱……以各种酷刑之名施加在萤火身上的陷阱。男人们满足了他们各种各样的欲望。

*《魔法少女妖精骑士》*Another Story
伊尔基尔的魅惑诡计让妖精骑士们陷入了困境。在看似完全堕入被施加的淫邪诅咒之后，她们获得了新的力量来反击伊尔基尔！随后是与八道终极头目的决战！

*《我和彩子与诱惑邮件》*Another Story
学生京一和他的阿姨兼老师彩子相爱了。两人在学校里秘密进行着这段恋情。这件事被彩子多管闲事的同事照岛拍了下来。于是他不仅能将毒牙伸向彩子，还能伸向她的女儿志穗。一部在正篇中无法容纳的、关于志穗的禁忌NTR邮件剧情。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094473.html]DLsite English[/url]]
